findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_product_details" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Get the details of one or more products. The details are the variants, the options, and the images. Arguments productIds - The list of product IDs. Get these ID…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "get_product_details" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Get the details of one or more products. The details are the variants, the options, and the images. Arguments productIds - The list of product IDs. Get these ID…

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_product_details" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: add_item_to_cart, get_product_details, remove_item_from_cart, update_cart_item · Private data: get_product_details, search_products · Public sink: add_item_to_cart, get_product_details, remove_item_from_cart, search_products, update_cart_item · Destructive: remove_item_from_cart.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: add_item_to_cart, get_product_details, remove_item_from_cart, update_cart_item · Private data: get_product_details, search_products · Public sink: add_item_to_cart, get_product_details, remove_item_from_cart, search_products, update_cart_item · Destructive: remove_item_from_cart

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "add_item_to_cart" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
